purpose: Route evidence beyond the canonical organizer/Trace manifest. These references may support race-day geometry, historical course reconstruction and source triangulation, but do not automatically assign course versions.
rules: A participant activity is evidence for a race-day recording only when the activity title/date/author can be linked to a known race participation or the activity text explicitly identifies the race.
An activity landing page without exportable coordinates is retained as a reference lead, not a local route asset.
Watch ascent is diagnostic only and must not be mixed directly with standardized cross-year elevation.
Mapped/copy routes are weaker than actual race-day recordings for reconstructing what runners physically followed.
Organizer map images can establish route-shape evidence but do not enable replay or exact distance projection without georeferencing or GPX geometry.

sources.evidence: Current 14 km Race-PM embeds this legacy-labelled organizer map/elevation image. It shows one loop from Christinehof with an eastern out-and-back/loop to the Hallamölla/Verkeån corridor and an approximately 13 km profile.
sources.limitation: The legacy 13 km label means the image alone must not be used to claim exact identity for every trail14 year or exact 2026 distance.
